title: India just built a chip that runs 300 times faster than the silicon in most electronics
sources: ANI/Ministry of Defence, September 2026 - DRDO implements indigenous advanced technology for next-generation radars, electronic warfare systems
Free Press Journal, September 2026 - India's DRDO achieves major breakthrough in homegrown chip tech for radars, electronic warfare
caption:
India just built a chip that runs 300 times faster than the silicon in most electronics. It's smaller than a fingernail.

DRDO's Solid State Physics Laboratory has indigenously developed Gallium Nitride semiconductor chips for next-generation radar and electronic warfare systems - a 3.5x3mm chip delivering up to 30 watts. The lab fabricated X-band Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuits and S-band GaN power amplifiers, built on indigenously grown 4-inch Silicon Carbide wafers, with some components delivering up to 150 watts. Limited production capability has already been set up at GAETEC, Hyderabad, targeting strategic defense systems, space and aerospace and 5G and satellite communications.

This isn't a chip India assembled. It's one India grew, from the wafer up.
